title: Ziyarat After Namaz
data:
Ziyarat of Imam Husayn (a):
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA ABAA A'BDIL LAAH
Peace be upon you, O Abu Abdillah,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA RASOOLIL LAAH
Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَابْنَ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA AMEERIL MU'MINEENA WABNA SAYYIDIL WASIYYEEN
Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful, and son of the chief of the successors,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَابْنَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاۤءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YABNA FAATIMATAZ ZAHRAAA-I SAYYIDATI NISAAA-IL A'ALAMEEN
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah al-Zahra, chief of the women of the worlds,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهٗ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKUM WA RAHMATUL LAAHI WA BARAKAATUH
Peace be upon you all, and Allah's mercy and blessings.
Ziyarat of Imam Rida (a):
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ وَابْنَ مَوْلَايَ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA WABNA MAWLAAYA
Peace be upon you, O my master and son of my master,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا غَرِيْبَ الْغُرَبَاۤءِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA GHAREEBAL GHURABAAA-I
Peace be upon you, O stranger among strangers,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سُلْطَانَ اَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلِيَّ ابْنَ مُوْسَى الرِّضَا وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهٗ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA SULTAANA ABAL HASANI A'LEE-YIBNI MOOSAR RIDAA WA RAHMATUL LAAHI WA BARAKAATUH
Peace be upon you, O Sultan, Abu'l-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, and Allah's mercy and blessings.
Ziyarat of Imam al-Zaman (a.t.f.s.):
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA SAAHIBAZ ZAMAAN
Peace be upon you, O Master of the Age,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيْفَةَ الرَّحْمٰنِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA KHALEEFATAR RAHMAAN
Peace be upon you, O Vicegerent of the All-beneficent,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَرِيْكَ الْقُرْاٰنِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA SHAREEKAL QUR-AAN
Peace be upon you, O Companion of the Qur'an,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَانَا صَاحِبَ الْعَصْرِ وَالزَّمَانِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA MAWLAANAA SAAHIBAL A'SRI WAZ ZAMAAN
Peace be upon you, O our master, Master of the era and the age,
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKUM WA RAHMATUL LAAHI WA BARAKAATUH
Peace be upon you all, and Allah's mercy and blessings.
